subject.title: browser tool: include current page URL in before_tool_call params for act/type actions

question: Should browser `before_tool_call` hooks receive a policy-safe current tab URL for `act`/`type`, and should that be exposed as enriched hook params or as an explicit browser state helper?
rationale: The missing URL blocks domain-pinned credential checks, but the API shape decides what browser state plugins may observe and must preserve browser URL redaction and SSRF policy boundaries.

options.title: Expose policy-safe hook URL
options.body: Add an additive documented hook-time URL field that reuses existing safe route URL semantics and omits the value when it cannot be safely resolved.

options.title: Add a scoped query helper
options.body: Keep hook params unchanged and expose a browser state helper that trusted plugins can call when a policy check needs the current URL.

options.title: Keep plugin-local caching
options.body: Leave core unchanged and require credential plugins to keep fail-secure tab URL caches from navigate/open and after-tool-call results.

recommendation.title: Expose policy-safe hook URL
recommendation.body: Add an additive documented hook-time URL field that reuses existing safe route URL semantics and omits the value when it cannot be safely resolved.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the strongest recent ownership signal across the browser tool and route policy surfaces where this contract would likely be decided.
